source.sha256_method: sha256 over 3 tables' full unfiltered COPY (ORDER BY code[, tradeday]) WITH (FORMAT CSV) output, each preceded by a 'TABLE:<schema>.<table>' header line, concatenated in fixed alphabetical order: nq_basicdata.stock, nq_marketdata.stock, nq_unadjprice2.daily
source.reuse_note: nq_basicdata.stock content overlaps byte-for-byte with the batch already pinned by security_master/security_profile (src_netquity_basicdata_80cfa8bd1c73), but this promotion's own correctness argument depends on the exact 3-table set it reads together (entity scope x currency x price x shares), so it mints its own self-contained batch rather than cross-referencing another promotion's pin -- same reasoning financial_facts used for its own 7-table batch.

promotion.serving_dataset_domain_note: dataset and domain are both literally 'quote_snapshot' (exact match against aiphabee_core.serving_dataset_domain_check); unlike financial_facts there is no plural/singular naming mismatch here.
promotion.new_index_required_reason: entity_id lookup uses the leading prefix of the existing serving_record unique index (serving_snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, ...)

rights_basis.distinct_from_prior_slices: security_master/security_profile/financial_facts all use rights_policy_version 'netquity-collaboration-staging.v1'; this promotion deliberately uses a new, distinct value because market-data Web distribution rights were confirmed separately from the original security/financial data rights approval.
rights_basis.note: owner 于 2026-07-15 确认 Netquity 合约涵盖行情数据 web 分发
rights_basis.account_context_independence: the account's single active platform.workspace_product_access.policy_version stays 'netquity-collaboration-staging.v1' (unchanged, so the 3 existing RPCs are unaffected); resolveQuoteSnapshot filters aiphabee_governance.data_entitlement/aiphabee_core.serving_dataset by the hardcoded NETQUITY_MARKET_DATA_RIGHTS_POLICY_VERSION constant instead of the account-context rights_policy_version, so this dataset's rights basis is independent of -- and does not require any platform.* schema/data change to -- the account's general product-access policy version.

shares_outstanding_column_choice.verification: issue_cap * lastprice reproduces nq_marketdata.stock.marketcap (vendor's own derived product) within 1 unit for 2805 of 2808 rows with all 3 values populated; total_issue_cap * lastprice only reproduces marketcap for 2321 of 2808 rows, with billion-scale mismatches on the rest -- total_issue_cap appears to include a different multi-class share mix on some instruments. marketcap itself is not promoted (it is a vendor-computed derived value, not a 1:1 source column).

eod_not_realtime.note: nq_unadjprice2.daily carries exactly one row per code in this mirror, all dated the same trade day. The live type, worker resolver, and every UI surface describe this as a closing price as of that trade date, never as real-time or live-streaming data.
eod_not_realtime.not_promoted: the vendor's single-character nq_unadjprice2.daily.status column is deliberately not promoted: its exact business meaning is not documented anywhere in the mirrored schema (status='T', 9017 rows, always has null open/high/low and a real zero volume/turnover, whose precise cause is unverifiable from this table alone), so promoting it risks asserting an unverified interpretation. The coverage/nullable-field representation already conveys the real data truthfully without it.

nullable_field_semantics.note: within an 'available' record, individual price/volume fields are independently nullable and omitted via jsonb_strip_nulls when the vendor row has them null -- never backfilled, carried forward, or estimated.
nullable_field_semantics.verified_sample_suspended: status='S' (304 rows) rows have every price/volume field null -- no frozen last price is carried forward for a currently-suspended instrument in this mirror.
nullable_field_semantics.verified_sample_zero_volume: status='T' (9017 rows) rows always have null open/high/low and a real (non-null) volume/turnover of exactly 0; close is populated for 7346 of them.

derived_panel_valuation_unblock.clean_input_mapping_confirmed: market_cap = quote.close * quote.sharesOutstanding is a computable, correctly-typed formula within packages/workbench's existing DERIVED_METRIC_DEFINITIONS/required_inputs framework in principle.
derived_panel_valuation_unblock.why_not_wired: packages/workbench's StockWorkbenchDerivedMetrics/createDerivedMetrics is entirely synthetic-typed (live_data_access: false is a literal type, not just a runtime value) and DerivedPanel is not decoupled from it (still receives `section` from the synthetic snapshot, unlike FinancialsPanel/QuotePanel). Live-enabling it cleanly would require either a new cross-dataset authorization primitive spanning financial_facts + quote_snapshot simultaneously (neither existing entitlement chain grants both together) or a client-side combination of two independently-authorized live queries plus a new exported live-valuation function in packages/workbench -- both are a new architecture pattern with no existing template to mechanically copy, which conflicts with this task's 'replicate the same pattern, do not redesign the route' instruction and is disproportionate risk for a secondary/optional goal on top of the already-large primary quote_snapshot promotion.
derived_panel_valuation_unblock.blocked_reason_unchanged: packages/workbench's 'market_cap_unavailable' blocked_reason is left as-is: it remains accurate for the synthetic-only DerivedPanel code path regardless of this promotion (that path has never had any shares-outstanding source, live or synthetic), so there is nothing stale to correct.
derived_panel_valuation_unblock.sharesOutstanding_coverage_caveat: even if wired, only 2809 of 17495 available quote records (16%) carry sharesOutstanding, so most instruments would remain blocked on 'shares_outstanding_unavailable' regardless.
